stations.name: Open field - MARCH
stations.instruction: Drag a hero 15 squares to the far point: it leads, the pack balls up BEHIND its last step. Try the point behind the pillar.

dropFar.note: 15 squares east of Hero 1 on open floor: leader on the drop square, pack behind it

dropRound.note: just behind the pillar: the route bends, 'behind' follows the last step

drawings.text: Drag a hero 15 squares to the far point: it leads, the pack balls up BEHIND its last step. Try the point behind the pillar.

stations.name: Arena - SWARM
stations.instruction: Drag the monsters onto a token: swarm round it (hostile Medium / Large, friend, prop); the hidden token is a march; the pen target through its door.

dropM.note: on the Medium target: leader touches it on its own side, the 8 touching squares fill from each member's side, the rest in ring 2

dropL.note: on the Large target: 12 touching squares

dropHidden.note: on the hidden token: a march, never a swarm, also for the GM

dropFriend.note: heroes onto a friendly token: a swarm

dropProp.note: heroes onto a prop: a swarm

dropPen.note: the pen target: file in through the door, then fan out round it

drawings.text: Drag the monsters onto a token: swarm round it (hostile Medium / Large, friend, prop); the hidden token is a march; the pen target through its door.

stations.name: One-wide tunnel
stations.instruction: Drag the four heroes 11 squares into the 1x1 tunnel: a line behind the leader. Scenario back: leader at the back walks through its mates.

back.note: the four in line inside the tunnel, the leader (Hero 1) last

dropIn11.note: 11 squares into the tunnel: a line behind the leader, nobody named

dropDeep.note: the dead end of the tunnel

drawings.text: Drag the four heroes 11 squares into the 1x1 tunnel: a line behind the leader. Scenario back: leader at the back walks through its mates.

stations.name: Twenty-monster tunnel
stations.instruction: 20 monsters in a 1-wide tunnel 30 long, a room at each end. Drag to room E: all follow in file. Scenario cap: 24 accepted, 25 refused.

front.note: the leader (Monster 1) at the front of the queue, nearest room E

back.note: the leader (Monster 1) at the BACK of the queue; Monster 20 at the front

cap.note: five more monsters (21-25) in room W: select 24 (accepted) and 25 (refused with the notice)

dropE.note: room E at the far end of the tunnel

dropW.note: room W at the near end

drawings.text: 20 monsters in a 1-wide tunnel 30 long, a room at each end. Drag to room E: all follow in file. Scenario cap: 24 accepted, 25 refused.

stations.name: Spiral C stair
stations.instruction: Drag from room A to room B over the C: one smooth motion on the centre line (0.4 square at the narrowest). Scenarios long, mud.

long.note: the 2-wide door on A's north wall is open: a long way round to B

mud.note: a Difficult Terrain region (walk x2) painted over the whole stair

dropMid.note: mid-stair, the narrowest point (0.4 square): a click here rests off-grid on the centre line

dropStair45.note: a point on the centre line

stair.note: narrowest clear width of the C, mid-way

drawings.text: Drag from room A to room B over the C: one smooth motion on the centre line (0.4 square at the narrowest). Scenarios long, mud.

stations.name: Passage shapes
stations.instruction: From the hall: S-curve, diagonal slit 0.4, funnel to 0.3 (passes), slit 0.2 (refused), hairpin (lanes share squares), pillar field.

dropScurve.note: pocket at the end of the S-curve (1.0 wide)

dropSlit.note: pocket behind the 0.2 slit: refused, nobody moves

dropHairpin.note: west end of the lower lane: the way is east along the upper lane, round the U, back west

dropField.note: far end of the pillar field

hall.note: the hall where the two heroes start

hairpin.note: two 1.0 lanes divided by one wall; lane row yc is off-grid (x.5)

drawings.text: From the hall: S-curve, diagonal slit 0.4, funnel to 0.3 (passes), slit 0.2 (refused), hairpin (lanes share squares), pillar field.

stations.name: Doors
stations.instruction: Eight heroes in the hall. Doors: open, closed, locked, double, diagonal, and a SECRET door to the vault (never used by a route).

allopen.note: every ordinary door open (open, closed, double, diagonal); the locked and the secret door stay as they are

dropR1.note: the room behind the OPEN door: a group files in one at a time and spreads out

dropVault.note: the vault: a route goes the LONG way round (east corridor), never through the secret door

drawings.text: Eight heroes in the hall. Doors: open, closed, locked, double, diagonal, and a SECRET door to the vault (never used by a route).

stations.name: Unexplored room
stations.instruction: Mode sight: from the start room, drag into the room round the corner you have not seen: no route over unexplored ground. The GM is unaffected.

dropU.note: the room round the corner (never seen)

dropCorridor.note: along the corridor, in line of sight

drawings.text: Mode sight: from the start room, drag into the room round the corner you have not seen: no route over unexplored ground. The GM is unaffected.

stations.name: Dead end
stations.instruction: Drag behind the end wall: 'No route there', nobody moves. Drag into the pocket: a line or a ball behind the leader. Scenario past: a member is already deeper.

past.note: Hero 4 already past the pocket, at the end of the corridor

dropBehind.note: behind the end wall (a sealed room): 'No route there'

drawings.text: Drag behind the end wall: 'No route there', nobody moves. Drag into the pocket: a line or a ball behind the leader. Scenario past: a member is already deeper.

stations.name: Narrow bridge
stations.instruction: Six heroes cross a 1-wide, 12-long bridge over a chasm (move-only walls): single file, spread out after, nobody in the chasm. Click on the bridge.

dropChasm.note: over the chasm: must not be a resting place

drawings.text: Six heroes cross a 1-wide, 12-long bridge over a chasm (move-only walls): single file, spread out after, nobody in the chasm. Click on the bridge.

stations.name: Mud
stations.instruction: Drag east: the route takes the cheaper way (round, dry) because the straight corridor is Difficult Terrain; in a fight only mud squares cost double.

drawings.text: Drag east: the route takes the cheaper way (round, dry) because the straight corridor is Difficult Terrain; in a fight only mud squares cost double.

stations.name: One-way walls
stations.instruction: West->middle wall is open from the west only; middle->east wall open from the middle only. A loop returns. Routes use the open side only.

dropE.note: east room: from the west or the middle a route passes both walls from their open sides

dropW.note: west room: from the east the way is the return corridor, never through the walls

dropM.note: middle room: from the east the way is round the loop and through the west wall

drawings.text: West->middle wall is open from the west only; middle->east wall open from the middle only. A loop returns. Routes use the open side only.

stations.name: Door too narrow
stations.instruction: A Large (2x2) and a Huge (3x3) with four heroes: the 1-wide door is too narrow, a 4-wide way round exists. Scenario noround shuts it.

noround.note: the wide way round is walled shut at its middle: only the 1-wide door is left

dropE.note: east room: the Large takes the wide way round; with none it stops before the door and the GM is whispered

dropMouth.note: the mouth of the door, west side

drawings.text: A Large (2x2) and a Huge (3x3) with four heroes: the 1-wide door is too narrow, a 4-wide way round exists. Scenario noround shuts it.

stations.name: Two-way lane
stations.instruction: Two screens at once: Player8A drags Heroes 1-4 to the east end while Player8B drags Heroes 5-8 to the west end. No deadlock, nobody left on anybody.

drawings.text: Two screens at once: Player8A drags Heroes 1-4 to the east end while Player8B drags Heroes 5-8 to the west end. No deadlock, nobody left on anybody.

stations.name: Crowd behind a wall
stations.instruction: Drag the twelve villagers to the far side of the wall: they converge on the only door (6 squares aside), go through one at a time, ball up behind the leader.

dropBeyond.note: beyond the wall: they converge on the door, none through the wall

drawings.text: Drag the twelve villagers to the far side of the wall: they converge on the only door (6 squares aside), go through one at a time, ball up behind the leader.

stations.name: Fight yard
stations.instruction: Scenario fight starts a combat. Drag the group: the leader first, then one at a time, 5 ft a square; the slow member stops where its speed ends.

fight.note: a combat is running: every token here is a combatant, Hero 1 has the turn

dropFight.note: group drag target: Hero 3 stands in the leader's lane, the ally is not in the drag

drawings.text: Scenario fight starts a combat. Drag the group: the leader first, then one at a time, 5 ft a square; the slow member stops where its speed ends.
